title: Being said 'because he's here'
summary: Mario Woods tells of Being said 'because he's here', about November 1977 at Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: He said because he's here. And they didn't say didn't say my name, didn't say his name, just said because he's here.

plain: An Air Force veteran named Mario Woods says that in November 1977, in the field of nuclear missile sites around Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, he and others had an encounter he describes as an abduction. He recalls hearing the words "because he's here", with no names spoken, as if the reason for what happened was the presence of one particular person.
